$comment: Checkpoint 2 — 26 Ringgold St (SOL and Associates, A-100 1st floor, A-800 wall types, A-400 sections). Four panels up to 16' read from the architect's plan; SAB's structural set (headers, wall height, species) is NOT in the PDF — everything that depends on it is marked as a hypothesis. Exterior dimensions are to the outer face of stud (note 8); window and door dimensions are to the centerline (notes 9 and 10). S12.5: openings by tag + centerline (as A-100 dimensions them) with the catalog in config.openingTypes — "A2" is the pair of type A windows (2 x 2'-5" x 6'-0") with the RO of hypothesis P28 made explicit; "1" is door 1 (36x80, metal frame) with the RO of hypothesis P29 made explicit, now equal to the default HM frame allowance (P34 revised on 2026-10-15; before, it gave 40 1/2" x 83"); "U2" is door U2 (36x80, wood) with the default allowance (P33). Same 90 pieces as before. Hypotheses (P27–P31): (1) wall height 9'-1 1/8" (10'-0" floor to floor minus ~10 7/8" of floor; precut stud 104 5/8"); (2) pair of type A windows (2x 2'-5" x 6'-0", casement with transom) with RO 58 1/2" x 72 1/2" and top of RO at 96 1/4" above subfloor (sill at 2'-0" on elevation A-200); (3) 36x80 door with RO 38" x 82 1/2"; (4) header from IRC Table R602.7(1): snow 30 psf, width 29', 2 floors above (1st-floor wall of a 3-story building), wind 130 mph exposure B — SAB's structural set governs when it arrives; (5) the longer wall runs through at the corner (north and south run through at the west), so x=0 = outer corner of the building; (6) I1 is non-bearing (partition between bedrooms, type 1, 2x4). S2 is the second panel of the south wall (starts 12' from the corner), hence layoutOrigin -12'. S35: wall types from A-800 in `config.wallTypes` — X1 (2x6 exterior; A-100 note 2: all new exterior walls are type X1) and 1 (2x4 interior partition; note 3) — with the architect's tag on each wall (`wallType`). The partition types do not say whether a wall is bearing, so every wall keeps its own section, exterior and bearing; the tag goes on the sheets and in `panels.csv`. Same panels and pieces as before (cut list and BOM unchanged).
